comment.text: FUBP1 R430 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; Breast tumors; Cervical tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: esophagusstomach; Prostate tumors. Additional source tumor types are retained in the structured record. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting FUBP1 residue R430 have been observed in uterine tumors, bowel tumors, and breast tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
